Opening a viewer captures its configured button command, matching reference ownership. Actual clicked canvas coordinates reach the chosen zoom centre; fit/fill switching preserves current zoom type and cycles100% ->fit ->fill ->100%, with reference recentering and large-file clamp rules. limits: This leaf covers the top-hover button configuration. It does not claim zoom menu expansion, backend-specific scaling options or preview zoom defaults. The command is frozen at viewer construction, as in the reference; changing the option affects newly opened viewers.

claims.behavior: Exact Always Loop Animations checkbox defaulttrue stages until Apply, persists and imports always_loop_gifs. Native animation players in media viewer/archive-delete/duplicate filters read the preference at each wrap and honor file play counts when false, pausing on the final frame after the stored count. Stored0 and ugoira mean infinite; missing GIF loop metadata means1. The existing mpv consumer captures GIF/APNG metadata at file load, pauses/seeks to start after the finite restart count and uses newly applied preference on the next load. Slideshow stop remains independent. Fresh actual Qt decoding/painting/timer output covers stored0/1/2 with forced looping on/off; separate real GIF/APNG reads cover finite/infinite/absent metadata. Tests cover controls, migration, decoded-native finite pause/live changes, owned viewer final-frame stability/resume, Cancel/reopen and existing MPV backend when available.
limits: This adds no absent animation backend. Native animation decoding remains WebP/ugoira; existing GIF/APNG playback requires libmpv. The MPV regression runs only where libmpv is available, as existing player tests do; metadata parsing and native decoded-frame regressions are unconditional. Existing MPV restart polling behavior is retained. Enabling looping does not resume already paused media, matching the reference.
